name: component-connect-connect-closes-a-loop-without-over-determining
source:
COMPONENT Pump2(in, out)
  PARAM dP
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.P    = in.P + dP
  out.h    = in.h
END
COMPONENT Pipe2(in, out)
  PARAM dP
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.P    = in.P - dP
  out.h    = in.h
END
Pump2 P(dP=50000)
Pipe2 L(dP=50000)
connect(P.out, L.in)
connect(L.out, P.in)

P.in.P    = 100000
P.in.mdot = 5
P.in.h    = 1000
